Class SoundService

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.service.SoundService
public class SoundService extends Object
Service for playing sounds to players with safe key resolution.

This service provides utility methods for playing sounds to individual players, all online players (broadcast), or all players in a specific world. Sound keys are resolved safely — invalid keys result in a warning log rather than an exception.

Example:

SoundService soundService = new SoundService();
soundService.playSound(player, "ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP", 1.0f, 1.5f);
soundService.broadcastSound("BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_PLING", 1.0f, 1.0f);

      public Optional<org.bukkit.Sound> resolveSound(String soundKey)
      Resolves a sound key string to a Bukkit Sound enum value.
      Parameters:
      soundKey - the sound key (case-insensitive)

      an Optional containing the resolved sound, or empty if invalid

    • playSound

      public boolean playSound(org.bukkit.entity.Player player, String soundKey, float volume, float pitch)
      Plays a sound to a specific player.
      Parameters:
      player - the player to play the sound for
      soundKey - the sound key (case-insensitive)
      volume - the volume level (1.0 is normal)
